owner_uid: core owner id; one per organization across spellings
exempt_parcels / exempt_value: parcels the roll marks exempt, and their assessed value, dollars
agreement_parcels / agreement_value: parcels under a tax agreement (Boston: Chapter 121A; Providence: stabilization agreements)
taxed_parcels / taxed_value / tax_billed: the owner's taxable parcels, assessed value and the tax the roll bills
agreement_*: the owner's PILOT row for the fiscal year named, as the city publishes it (Boston: PILOT recap)
agreement_pct_met: the city's own figure: cash plus community-benefit credit, over the requested PILOT
